title: Unlocking the Capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models for Generalizable and Explainable Deepfake Detection
summary: Two local reproducibility/reporting defects; video AUC definition coherent, benchmark and causal interpretation remain bounded.

problems.title: Inference parser has history-dependent unmatched-response labels
assumptions: Unmatched response contains none of the exact tested strings
Module loop proceeds after a prior assigned label
problems.check: Static ordered-condition reasoning plus independent transition model
problems.result: Same response inherits prior0 or1; first unmatched item leaves name unassigned
problems.counterevidence: Historical benchmark evaluator unavailable; default may be implemented there
problems.impact: Released helper defect; no demonstrated published AUC change
problems.correction: Per-image default zero removes carryover; complete parser and evaluator validation still required

independent_verification.original_claim_and_assumptions: Appendix A.1, physical p.13, specifies 32 uniformly sampled frames and a real default for unmatched text. The complete frozen inference.py was statically read, including the module-level loop at lines 94-112; pred is assigned only in six ordered substring conditions and has no prior initialization. This is a current released helper, not an identified historical video evaluator.
independent_verification.decisive_independent_check: Fresh control-flow examination: the response "The image is a genuine photograph." contains none of pristine, deepfake, Yes, No. All assignments are skipped. At module scope the first such item raises NameError on the print; following pred=0 or pred=1 it reuses that value. A separate standard-library string check confirms all conditions are false, with no author program imported or run. The recorded transition-model outputs agree.
independent_verification.alternative_readings_and_counterevidence: An omitted historical evaluator may initialize a default correctly. Appendix A.1 also makes the video AUC mathematically coherent: 32 binary votes give 33 possible ranking scores, not merely balanced accuracy. Independently checked all four positive-negative pairs in the stated 16/32,24/32 versus 1/32,8/32 example are correctly ranked. No error in the definition of this AUC is established.
independent_verification.core_dependency_severity_and_repair: Minor: unmatched labels in this helper depend on history, but no propagation to published AUC has been shown. Per-iteration pred=0 removes carryover and implements the default; it does not validate case handling, negation, ordered overrides, or the unavailable full video evaluator. No historical impact or general parser repair is certified.
independent_verification.outcome: Retain bounded Minor finding; report and findings are consistent with independently established evidence.

problems.title: Timing-table dataset attribution does not match main AUC entries
problems.location: p14 Table10 versus p6 Table1 and p7 Table3
problems.claim: Joint timing and AUC on CDF2
assumptions: Same named methods and printed dataset labels
problems.check: Four-entry vector comparison; original PDF visual inspection
problems.result: All four AUC entries match CDF1; all differ from published CDF2 values
problems.counterevidence: Caption typo or different run possible; raw run records absent
problems.impact: Ambiguous speed/accuracy comparison dataset; no fabrication claim
problems.correction: Clarify caption/values using original runs; no validated replacement available

independent_verification.original_claim_and_assumptions: Physical p.14 Table 10 explicitly captions the timing/AUC comparison as CDF2. I visually inspected the original page and compared its named methods against physical p.6 Table 1 and p.7 Table 3.
independent_verification.decisive_independent_check: Fresh transcriptions in order CADDM, Ours-KFD, FAK-Owl, Ours-LVLM: Table 10 [85.68,97.62,69.84,95.97], CDF1 [85.68,97.62,69.84,95.97], CDF2 [93.88,94.71,60.85,89.90]. Exact four-entry comparison confirms identity with CDF1 and disagreement with every CDF2 entry. This independently agrees with the existing reviewer output.
independent_verification.alternative_readings_and_counterevidence: A caption typo, copied AUC column, or different run/configuration could explain this. No run provenance establishes the actually timed dataset. Appendix A.4 explicitly acknowledges LVLM performance decline; the report correctly distinguishes that admission and lower LVLM scores from the parser and table defects.
independent_verification.core_dependency_severity_and_repair: Minor: the joint speed/accuracy dataset attribution is ambiguous; this does not establish falsified measurements or invalidate the separate main benchmark tables. Resolve against original runs before changing caption or values; no replacement number is certified.
independent_verification.outcome: Retain bounded Minor finding; no scientific or TeX correction needed.
